title: Changelog
description: All notable changes to Zenith Companion will be documented in this file. Updates are organized chronologically by release date.

items.title: What's New in Zenith
items.description: Added a dedicated in-app update log so you can easily track companion features, improvements, and fixes.
items.raw: - **What's New in Zenith**: Added a dedicated in-app update log so you can easily track companion features, improvements, and fixes.

items.title: Table & Catalog Pagination
items.description: Switched to fast page browsing across the Items and Enemies databases, eliminating scrolling lag on large catalogs.
items.raw: - **Table & Catalog Pagination**: Switched to fast page browsing across the Items and Enemies databases, eliminating scrolling lag on large catalogs.

items.title: Base Crafting Recipes
items.description: Added full recipe tracking for Smelting, Cooking, and Forge equipment directly into item details.
items.raw: - **Base Crafting Recipes**: Added full recipe tracking for Smelting, Cooking, and Forge equipment directly into item details.

items.title: Dropdown Menu Clipping
items.description: Fixed search and filter dropdowns occasionally clipping inside card containers.
items.raw: - **Dropdown Menu Clipping**: Fixed search and filter dropdowns occasionally clipping inside card containers.

items.title: Table Row Hover Highlights
items.description: Smoothed item table rows so selection borders remain continuous without notches.
items.raw: - **Table Row Hover Highlights**: Smoothed item table rows so selection borders remain continuous without notches.

items.title: Settings Toggles
items.description: Fixed duplicate checkmark icon on unchecked settings options and smoothed switch toggle animations.
items.raw: - **Settings Toggles**: Fixed duplicate checkmark icon on unchecked settings options and smoothed switch toggle animations.

items.title: Item Valuation & Market Trends
items.description: Clear sell advice comparing vendor, bartering, and market profit, with 30-day price trend graphs.
items.raw: - **Item Valuation & Market Trends**: Clear sell advice comparing vendor, bartering, and market profit, with 30-day price trend graphs.

items.title: Equipment Tier Simulator
items.description: Test weapon and armour tier upgrades with exact stat multipliers before investing materials.
items.raw: - **Equipment Tier Simulator**: Test weapon and armour tier upgrades with exact stat multipliers before investing materials.

items.title: Enemy Bestiary & Live Weather
items.description: Enemy details now display live weather synergies and drop tables with current market gold values.
items.raw: - **Enemy Bestiary & Live Weather**: Enemy details now display live weather synergies and drop tables with current market gold values.

items.title: Settings Overhaul
items.description: Reorganized settings into an uncluttered layout with quick toggles for audio and appearance preferences.
items.raw: - **Settings Overhaul**: Reorganized settings into an uncluttered layout with quick toggles for audio and appearance preferences.

items.title: Mobile Navigation Dock
items.description: A responsive bottom dock on mobile devices that keeps your most-used tools one tap away.
items.raw: - **Mobile Navigation Dock**: A responsive bottom dock on mobile devices that keeps your most-used tools one tap away.

items.title: Navigation Sidebar
items.description: Streamlined desktop navigation into cleaner categories with an optional collapsed icon rail mode.
items.raw: - **Navigation Sidebar**: Streamlined desktop navigation into cleaner categories with an optional collapsed icon rail mode.

items.title: Toast Notifications
items.description: Interactive feedback toasts for profile saves and export operations.
items.raw: - **Toast Notifications**: Interactive feedback toasts for profile saves and export operations.

items.title: Forge Lessons Calculator
items.description: Plan offline smithing training with exact burn times, EXP per hour, and gold costs.
items.raw: - **Forge Lessons Calculator**: Plan offline smithing training with exact burn times, EXP per hour, and gold costs.

items.title: Progression Goal Planner
items.description: Pick any target level and find the most efficient training route.
items.raw: - **Progression Goal Planner**: Pick any target level and find the most efficient training route.

items.title: Burn vs. Sell Inventory Tool
items.description: Compares 91 materials against live market values to decide whether to smelt or sell.
items.raw: - **Burn vs. Sell Inventory Tool**: Compares 91 materials against live market values to decide whether to smelt or sell.

items.title: Multi-Character Sync
items.description: Forge setups, queues, and inventories now save per character and switch instantly with your profile.
items.raw: - **Multi-Character Sync**: Forge setups, queues, and inventories now save per character and switch instantly with your profile.

items.title: Class Modifiers
items.description: Added Cursed and Forsaken character EXP penalties (-50%) to all training calculations.
items.raw: - **Class Modifiers**: Added Cursed and Forsaken character EXP penalties (-50%) to all training calculations.

items.title: Pet Directory Redesign
items.description: Redesigned the companion catalog with responsive cards, clean stat comparisons, and direct egg acquisition links.
items.raw: - **Pet Directory Redesign**: Redesigned the companion catalog with responsive cards, clean stat comparisons, and direct egg acquisition links.

items.title: Pet Setup Simulator
items.description: Consolidated level, mastery, and evolution stat controls into a collapsible simulator panel with instant calculation updates.
items.raw: - **Pet Setup Simulator**: Consolidated level, mastery, and evolution stat controls into a collapsible simulator panel with instant calculation updates.

items.title: Bounded Page Navigation
items.description: Switched from infinite scrolling to fast page navigation (12, 24, or 48 companions per page) for smoother browsing.
items.raw: - **Bounded Page Navigation**: Switched from infinite scrolling to fast page navigation (12, 24, or 48 companions per page) for smoother browsing.

items.title: Mobile Sheet Ergonomics
items.description: Companion and combat details now open in an edge-to-edge mobile bottom sheet with swipe-to-dismiss and floating back-to-top button.
items.raw: - **Mobile Sheet Ergonomics**: Companion and combat details now open in an edge-to-edge mobile bottom sheet with swipe-to-dismiss and floating back-to-top button.
